strings.name: Ron Vachris
strings.role: Costco president, chief executive officer and director
strings.summary: Ron Vachris began in warehouse work at Price Club and later managed regional operations, real estate development and merchandising. He became Costco president and chief operating officer in 2022, succeeding Craig Jelinek as CEO on January 1, 2024.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Official appointment dates are used, distinguishing the succession announcement from its effective date; birth date and specific degrees remain unverified.
strings.influence.rationale: His long service in Costco operations and leadership has contributed to the development of membership retail.
strings.facts.f1.label: Career beginnings
strings.facts.f1.value: He worked as a forklift driver at Price Club in 1982; the company merged with Costco in 1993.
strings.facts.f2.label: Management experience
strings.facts.f2.value: Before becoming CEO, he managed regional operations, real estate development and merchandising, and served as president and chief operating officer.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From warehouses to management
strings.highlights.h1.text: Extensive warehouse and regional operations experience underpins his retail management background.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Internal succession
strings.highlights.h2.text: He served as president and chief operating officer before becoming CEO; he is not a Costco founder.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Recent interview published
strings.timeline.t1.text: EatingWell published an interview about his career and company culture; this is the publication date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Becoming chief executive officer
strings.timeline.t2.text: He succeeded Craig Jelinek as CEO and remained president; the appointment was announced in October 2023.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becoming president and chief operating officer
strings.timeline.t3.text: He also joined the board, gaining experience ahead of the later CEO succession.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Leading merchandising
strings.timeline.t4.text: He became executive vice president of merchandising.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Leading real estate development
strings.timeline.t5.text: He became senior vice president of real estate development.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Leading the Northwest region
strings.timeline.t6.text: He became senior vice president and general manager of the Northwest region.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Managing San Diego regional operations
strings.timeline.t7.text: He was appointed vice president of operations for the San Diego region.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joining Price Club
strings.timeline.t8.text: He began his warehouse retail career as a forklift driver.
